compiled_decisions.surface_model: separate dark control sidebar, raised application canvas, modular panels
compiled_decisions.density: desktop-native high density with 14 px body, 12 px labels, 32 px controls
compiled_decisions.layout: 240 px sidebar, fluid center, 240 px hideable context inspector, 12 px gaps
compiled_decisions.hierarchy: compact heading and KPI strip; chart is primary; table is secondary but visible
compiled_decisions.radii: 20 px outer canvas, 16 px panels, 10 px controls, 8 px selected rows
compiled_decisions.controls: one search action; chart period, chart type, classic funnel filter, save, and fullscreen share one tight toolbar; chart overflow is removed
compiled_decisions.header_actions: the 32 px notification and overflow controls are anchored at the absolute top-right of the 1152 px global header; the Codex-like context-actions trigger is aligned directly below the notification
compiled_decisions.navigation: single hierarchical sidebar with no duplicate collapsed rail
compiled_decisions.tabs: fixed-width text-only Chart/Data switch with quiet default and active states; 120 ms hover adds the shared control surface without layout shift
compiled_decisions.action_alignment: chart fullscreen and table export share the same absolute vertical axis; table overflow precedes export with an 8 px gap
compiled_decisions.context_groups: the inspector is grouped as On this page, View, and Share; Copy link and Send by email use 216 by 32 px action rows
compiled_decisions.icons: monochrome Lucide-style 1.5 px strokes; no text glyphs or primitive rectangles
compiled_decisions.motion: subtle 120-180 ms feedback; reduced-motion state remains a runtime obligation
compiled_decisions.color: graphite neutral surfaces, semantic status colors, violet primary data series

source_classification.exploration_image_use: human decision evidence only; excluded from Figma executor input
